## Evidence discipline

- [ ] I distinguished enterprise / product-project / exact-patent metrics.
- [ ] I did not use post-T0 material as historical T0 evidence.
- [ ] I kept unproven facts as Unknown / inference.
- [ ] R1–R5 has realization-stage evidence.
- [ ] R3–R5 has an exact-patent → value-carrier link.
- [ ] R5, if used, has E4 plus an attributable exact-patent metric.
- [ ] Third-party source documents are linked/cited, not improperly relicensed.
